chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn Asbat, from Asbat ibn Salim, who said:
A man from the people of Hit asked him, while I was present.
About the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: “And thus We have revealed to you a Spirit from Our command.”
So he said: “Since Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sent down that Spirit upon Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله, it has not ascended to the heaven, and it is surely within us.”

key_terms.أَمْرِنَا: Our command; the divine command or affair from which this Spirit proceeds.
key_terms.أَنْزَلَ: Sent down; indicates the descent of this Spirit from Allah.
key_terms.السَّمَاءِ: The heaven; the realm to which the Spirit did not ascend after its descent.
key_terms.رُوحًا: A Spirit from Allah’s command, understood here as a divine reality sent down upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله.
key_terms.صَعِدَ: Ascended; here it is negated, meaning the Spirit did not return to the heaven.
key_terms.لَفِينَا: Surely within us; indicating the Spirit’s presence with the Imams عليهم السلام.

ai.seo_question: What does the verse “And thus We revealed to you a Spirit from Our command” mean in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the verse about the Spirit revealed by Allah as referring to a continuing divine reality that did not depart after being sent down upon the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله. In this report, the Imam عليه السلام states that this Spirit remains with them, indicating a special divine support and protection associated with the Imams عليهم السلام.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Ali Bin Asbat, from Asbat Bin Salim who said,
‘A man from the people of Hayt asked him<sup>asws</sup> and I was present,
about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [42:52] And thus We Revealed to you a Spirit from Our Command.
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Since Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Sent down the Spirit unto Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>, it has not ascended to the sky, and it is within us<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ali ibn Asbat from Asbat ibn Salim who has said the following.
“Once a man from Hayt (a town in Iraq) asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.), -when I was present also-, about the words of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High.
“Thus, We have revealed a Spirit to you, (Muhammad), by Our command. Before, you did not even know what a Book or Faith was, . .” [42:52]
The Imam (a.s.) said, “From the day Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, sent that Spirit to Muhammad (s.a.) he did not ever since ascent and he is present with us.”
